title: Algebraic independence is unchanged by an algebraic base extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq E\subseteq K$ be a tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension], with $E/k$ algebraic: every element of $E$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial over $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-element]. Let $I$ be an index set and let $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ be a family in $K$. Then the family is algebraically independent over $k$ if and only if it is algebraically independent over $E$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree].
